notes: Intakes: no dated deadline for non-EU/foreign-diploma applicants is stated on the supplied pages (the Moroccan Bac holder must use Études en France; the ADIUT 1 Oct–15 Nov window belongs to the BUT programme, not this licence), so the intake is left with all dates null and only a routing quote. Tuition: 2 902 €/year for licence is the institution-wide differentiated rate for extra-community students at Lyon 2, quoted on the university fee page and stated as applying in 2026/2027; the Parcoursup fiche only shows 178 €/year and is silent on the non-EU rate. Documents: the only document check-list found is the general international student guide (attestation(s) de niveau de langue, diplômes antérieurs traduits et certifiés conformes, extrait de naissance traduit et apostillé) and it is not a list specific to this programme, so no documents fact is given.
